news.title: STAT+: House Democrat seeks to scrap No Surprises Act’s costly arbitration process
news.summary: A new proposal in Congress to scrap a surprise billing ban’s controversial arbitration system will need to to survive an onslaught of attacks from provider groups.

news.title: NIH funding uncertainty thwarts U.S. researchers
news.summary: How has the NIH been spending its budget? And why are biotech investors feeling gloomy? Find out on this week's episode of "The Readout LOUD" podcast.

news.title: STAT+: AI for breast cancer risk prediction goes DTC, regulatory cloud over Utah sandbox, and AI psychosis
news.summary: In this edition of STAT's Health Tech: The story of a startup taking its algorithm for breast cancer risk prediction directly to patients, and more.

news.title: STAT+: The fresh faces that may shake up key Senate committees ahead of midterms
news.summary: Dozens of Democrats are vying for seats on the House Energy and Commerce and Ways and Means committees, with several members from both parties either leaving or in close races.

news.title: STAT+: Roche goes beyond licensing in deal with Chinese biotech
news.summary: Roche is partnering with Chinese startup Defand Therapeutics to discover new medicines.

news.title: FDA says its safety review of abortion pill will continue into next year
news.summary: The FDA says its ongoing safety review of the nation's main abortion pill will continue into next year, a timeline that was quickly condemned by abortion opponents.

news.title: STAT+: Argenx sees unusual setback with failure of late-stage study of drug for autoimmune disease
news.summary: Argenx said its blockbuster drug Vyvgart didn’t outperform placebo in a Phase 3 trial of patients with Sjögren's disease, a chronic autoimmune disorder.

news.title: STAT+: Pharmalittle: We’re reading about PhRMA suing Trump, biotech frustration over tariffs, and more
news.summary: PhRMA is suing the Trump administration, smaller biotech firms are frustrated over tariffs, and more of the latest pharma news.

news.title: STAT+: Roche inks drug discovery deal with Chinese biotech, focused on molecular glue medicines
news.summary: Roche has inked a drug discovery deal with Chinese biotech Defand Therapeutics, focused on molecular glue medicines.

news.title: The Nobel boys club (again)
news.summary: All six Nobel awardees in physiology or medicine, physics, and chemistry this year were men. Women make up 4% of laureates since the award’s inception.

news.title: STAT+: Biotech companies are struggling to navigate Trump’s new tariffs
news.summary: Smaller biotech firms are trying to figure out how to win exemptions from Trump's import taxes.

news.title: STAT+: Dozens of Democrats vie for slots on key House health committees
news.summary: Power House health committees could get a lot of new members after the midterms.

news.title: Opinion: How CMS plans to fix a major flaw in the 340B drug discount program
news.summary: “A small, well-intended discount for safety net hospitals became a large institutional subsidy with expensive unintended consequences,” writes an HHS leader.

news.title: Opinion: England and other nations are on the path toward eliminating hepatitis C. Why not the U.S.?
news.summary: Eliminating hepatitis C is achievable — if the U.S. seriously invests in it, experts write.

news.title: Little room for stakeholder consensus among potential Medicare Advantage reforms
news.summary: A survey of 52 experts spanning researchers, the Medicare Advantage industry, patient advocates and policymakers wasn't able to identify a single policy proposal that would be received wholeheartedly by all three groups.

news.title: CMS: About 71% of MAPD plan enrollees in coverage with four or more stars for 2027
news.summary: The Trump administration has released the 2027 Medicare Advantage star ratings, with many enrollees in plans that earned at least four stars.

news.title: HHS launches 4 new vaccine injury research, reporting initiatives
news.summary: The U.S. Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) on Thursday announced a series of actions aimed at strengthening the federal government's response to vaccine-related health concerns.

news.title: HHS: 340B 'expanded beyond its original intent,' incentivizes consolidation
news.summary: A new brief lays out the administration's views and critiques of the controversial hospital subsidy program, and includes a data analysis suggesting that a proposed reimbursement cut will limit spending growth.

news.title: Chutes & Ladders—WellSpan, Beth Israel Lahey unveil next CEOs
news.summary: Welcome to this week's Chutes & Ladders, our roundup of hirings, firings and retirings throughout the industry. Please submit the good news—or the bad—from your shop, and we will feature it here at the end of each week.

news.title: 'Blue Conspiracy'—Michigan attorney general hits BCBSM with antitrust suit
news.summary: Michigan Attorney General Dana Nessel has filed suit against Blue Cross Blue Shield of Michigan, alleging that the insurer operated as a monopoly in the state.

news.title: Fierce Healthcare Fundraising Tracker '26: Outro clinches $7M for deprescribing; Rightway pulls in $155M to expand pharmacy benefits tech
news.summary: Keep up with all the venture capital dollars being funneled into the health tech and digital health industries.

news.title: Suki launches ‘Ask’ feature for clinical decision support driven by Wolters Kluwer UpToDate AI API
news.summary: Ask integrates evidence-based clinical reasoning directly into workflows and can provide answers grounded in UpToDate’s proprietary content.

news.title: Healthleap banks $38M for AI screening platform that catches undiagnosed conditions
news.summary: Healthleap says its platform is the first and only validated AI malnutrition screening tool that contains EHR-integrated screening layers, executives say.

news.title: PhRMA launches new legal challenge as CMS brings 'most favored nation' pricing to Medicare Part B
news.summary: As the Trump administration advances plans to bring its “most favored nation” drug pricing model to Medicare Part B, the pharmaceutical industry’s top lobbying group is pushing back in court.

news.title: Kaiser Permanente to repay nurses 'potentially tens of millions' in mistakenly withheld wages
news.summary: Following an arbitration agreement, more than 1,000 nurses will be compensated for a payment error that began in 2021, the California Nurses Association said. The major nonprofit confirmed the plans but did not comment on the total amount.

news.title: After ICE raids, hospitals saw fewer ED visits, more admissions among foreign-born: study
news.summary: Studies published this week outline changes in care-seeking behavior tied to heightened federal immigration policy and rhetoric, with ramifications for patient outcomes and healthcare spending.

news.title: Endeavor’s threat to IPF incumbents increases after phase 2 win for Hedgehog inhibitor
news.summary: Endeavor BioMedicines solidified its potential threat to Big Pharma with a phase 2b readout suggesting its Hedgehog inhibitor could become the first drug to reduce lung fibrosis while increasing total lung capacity.

news.title: AI biotech Iambic aims for $135M IPO to push cancer drugs through clinic
news.summary: Iambic Therapeutics is aiming to raise $135 million in net proceeds from an IPO as the AI biotech looks to fund the clinical development of its lead cancer drug.

news.title: ‘It’s just survival now’: Why is almost a third of Boston’s life sciences lab space sitting vacant?
news.summary: Vacancy rates for lab and manufacturing spaces in Massachusetts increased 11-fold to 31% between 2021 and 2026. So what's gone wrong?

news.title: Ono pays $80M for regional rights to trio of Biohaven IgG degraders, including phase 3 Grave’s asset
news.summary: Japan’s Ono Pharmaceutical is paying $80 million upfront for the regional rights to a trio of Biohaven’s IgG degraders, led by a phase 3-stage Grave’s disease prospect.

news.title: Zealand, Roche’s ‘intriguing’ weight loss for amylin drug soured by blood sugar data
news.summary: Zealand Pharma has reported more phase 2 data on its Roche-partnered amylin analog, linking the drug candidate to competitive weight loss but a lackluster effect on blood sugar.

news.title: Argenx digests phase 2 celiac win for $2.2B drug, preps pivotal run
news.summary: A phase 2 celiac disease trial of argenx’s FB102 has hit its primary endpoint, delivering a boost to a drug candidate that the biotech acquired in its $2.2 billion takeover of Forte Biosciences.

news.title: Cadrenal launches strategic review for late-stage cardiology pipeline
news.summary: Cadrenal Therapeutics, a heart-focused biotech that recently reached an agreement with the FDA on the design of a pivotal trial for its lead candidate, is now instead looking to offload its pipeline or potentially the entire company.

news.title: Fierce Biotech Layoff Tracker 2026: Caribou cuts staff, halts pipeline; Foghorn reduces workforce by 40%
news.summary: As always, if you know of layoffs occurring at a biotech, please reach out to the Fierce Biotech editorial team.

news.title: ARPA-H unveils Surpass program to accelerate and expand clinical trials
news.summary: The U.S. Department of Health and Human Services announced the launch of a new program aimed at removing barriers that slow clinical development and transforming how clinical trials are designed and conducted.

news.title: TCGX launches $600M fund to bankroll Asian biotechs
news.summary: Investment firm TCGX is expanding in Asia, raising $600 million to funnel into biotechs emerging from a burgeoning drug discovery hotspot.

news.title: Cerevance rescues its Parkinson's drug with phase 3 win
news.summary: Cerevance's oral non-dopaminergic therapy has redeemed itself by improving both motor and non-motor symptoms in a phase 3 Parkinson's disease study.

news.title: Atsena’s Lighthouse gene therapy readout illuminates eye disease efficacy
news.summary: Atsena Therapeutics has reported evidence of efficacy in a clinical trial of an eye disease gene therapy, encouraging the biotech to forge ahead with a study that could support a filing for approval in 2028.

papers.summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are rapidly evolving toward continuous audio--visual reasoning, creating an urgent need for evaluations that expose their capability limits. Audio--visual captioning is an ideal diagnostic task, yet current benchmarks face a coupled trade-off: whole-caption scores provide coverage without localization, local probes provide localization without coverage, and unconstrained LLM judges introduce instability. papers.title: SpaceCast-Bench: Evaluating Predictive Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
papers.summary: Existing spatial reasoning benchmarks mainly test spatial perception: reading off relations already visible in the input. Yet real-world spatial intelligence demands predictive spatial reasoning: constructing a scene from observations, anticipating how an intervention changes it, and reasoning about the unseen outcome. We introduce SpaceCast-Bench, the first benchmark to directly and diagnostically evaluate this capability. papers.title: Agent Plasticity: Measuring Self-Improvement Through Experience
papers.summary: AI agents increasingly operate in environments where they can diagnose failures and improve through experience, yet existing evaluations largely measure what an agent can do at a fixed point in time rather than how effectively it learns. Evaluating self-improvement requires answering three questions: does future performance improve and generalize beyond the interactions that enabled learning; how efficiently are new capabilities acquired; and where does the self-improvement process break down?
